Coram : J.B. PARDIWALA*, MANOJ MISRA
Issue for Consideration Issue arose as to whether the execution court had jurisdiction to deal with the application for rescission of contract and extension of time to deposit the balance sale consideration; and if execution court had the jurisdiction, whether those applications ought to have in the suit on original side, if yes, then, whether, in the facts of the case, on that ground alone, the impugned order warrants interference in exercise of jurisdiction Art 136 of the Constitution. Headnotes† Specific Relief Act, 1963 – s. 28 – Rescission in certain
